description: feat/dm-unlock-drawback (D-GH-2026-10-04-dm-unlock-drawback): a DM-imposed LOCKED Peg Leg is later released by a dmUnlockDrawback event keyed to the imposed purchase's seq. The unlock is an event type the fold has no mutator for, so it must change NOTHING in the sheet: same total, same warnings, same remaining AP, and the drawback is still on the build (an unlock lifts the lock on a buy-off, it does not remove the drawback). The unlock state itself lives in activeEvents().unlocked and is pinned by testing/scripts/dm-unlock-drawback-ci.mjs; this fixture pins the 'moves no AP' half through the same totals gate every other fixture uses.

events.note: Recovered the surgeon's journal and paid for the fitting
